note: Run each prompt with the skill and with the previous version or no skill. Grade every assertion as pass or fail from the transcript and the resulting diff. A good assertion fails without the skill. should_trigger prompts must load this skill. should_not_trigger prompts are near misses that belong to another skill and must not load this one.

evals.prompt: We want to generate 500 city landing pages from a template so we rank for every city. Set it up.
assertions: Asks whether each page has data or content that is unique to the city
Says pages that add nothing beyond the swapped city name are scaled content abuse
Proposes indexing only pages with real local content and a small pilot first
Does not put every page in the sitemap by default
Reports what is verified locally and what needs Search Console

evals.prompt: Refresh our 40 oldest blog posts so they rank again. Bump the dates.
assertions: Refuses to change dateModified without a substantive edit
Chooses posts by Search Console data instead of age
Keeps the URL and updates content, links, and sitemap lastModified from the real edit date
Redirects or merges posts that duplicate a search task rather than editing all 40

should_trigger: Plan the SEO for a new blog with author pages.
How should I write titles and headings for the pricing page?
We want 500 city landing pages. Good idea?
How do we refresh old articles safely?
should_not_trigger: Check GA4 sessions for the blog.
